findings.title: Null pointer dereference in MaglevReducer::CanInlineCall direct-recursion check
findings.message: When MaglevGraphBuilder::CanInlineCall was moved/refactored into the shared MaglevReducer<BaseT>::CanInlineCall template, the direct-recursion self-inlining guard was rewritten from comparing against the builder's own `compilation_unit_->shared_function_info()` to instead reading `current_provenance().unit->shared_function_info()`. `current_provenance()` returns the MaglevGraphLabeller::Provenance record that is only populated/valid when a graph labeller is present and actively tracking node provenance (i.e. under ENABLE_GDB_JIT_INTERFACE / --gdbjit or tracing flags). In ordinary release builds / non-tracing configurations the `unit` field of the current provenance can be null, so dereferencing `current_provenance().unit->shared_function_info()` during non-eager inlining causes a SIGSEGV (null pointer dereference) instead of safely evaluating the recursion check against the always-valid current compilation unit.
findings.suggestion: Do not rely on the debug/tracing-only MaglevGraphLabeller provenance data for correctness-relevant logic such as the direct-recursion check. Pass the caller's actual MaglevCompilationUnit explicitly into CanInlineCall (as the fix does: `CanInlineCall(const MaglevCompilationUnit* current_unit, ...)`), guard the pointer with a null check, and compare against that explicit unit instead of `current_provenance().unit`.

ground_truth.root_cause: The direct-recursion self-inlining check was changed from reading the builder's own always-valid MaglevCompilationUnit pointer to instead reading MaglevGraphLabeller-derived provenance data, which is only guaranteed to be populated when GDB JIT interface support or graph tracing is active. This coupled a functional correctness check to an optional, debug-only subsystem, producing a null-pointer dereference when that subsystem was disabled (the common release-build case).

must_cover.reason: Primary location of finding: Null pointer dereference in MaglevReducer::CanInlineCall direct-recursion check
